g.text: Red Reserved pills are the only warm
colour on the page, so booked tables
stand out from free ones at a glance.
Identical card shape for every table;
status colour is the only difference.
Name, seats, guest and time sit together
inside each card. Action is last, inside
Each table shows 4 facts only: number,
One action per card, chosen by state:
Clear if reserved, Remove if free. Add-
40 to 44 px action buttons placed at the
card's bottom-left, away from the status
Status chips and a grid of cards are the
familiar way to show seating, like
